title: reconcile's harness pushes to local bare origins that env maintenance pins cannot reach — its qsn guard never traces a push
description:
reconcile's fixture pins its runner's environment with gitbin.WithNoAutoMaintenance and its trace guard (TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor) covers clone/add/commit/fetch — but its bare origin (harness_test.go:559) is created with no config pins, and every `git push` its tests make (closeout_test, evacuate_test, attempt_identity_test, adoption_test, gate_repair_test, …) starts git-receive-pack with GIT_CONFIG_COUNT stripped by git's local transport (connect.c pushes local_repo_env), so the env pin never reaches the process that ends each push by starting `git maintenance run --auto --detach` in a t.TempDir origin. Verified empirically while fixing 35l: with env pins present, an unpinned local bare still gets one detached maintenance per push (traced to receive-pack via trace2 child events); pinning the bare's own config (maintenance.auto=false, receive.autogc=false, gc.auto=0) suppresses it. This is the same one-in-forty CI-flake class 35l was absorbed for, in the package where the qsn incident happened — reconcile's guard stays green because its traced sequence simply has no push in it. The fix mirrors 35l's: pin the origin at creation in the harness, and add a push to the guard's traced sequence.
